title: How to use your knowledge to look after your mental health

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间以外的钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Marianne Trent博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己是在2022年完成该课程的，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长之路。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie提供的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过描述中链接的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: I'm Jo, and I work as an assistant practitioner in a CAMS service in Lancashire.
sentences.zh: 我是Jo，我在兰开夏郡的一家CAMS服务机构担任助理医师。

sentences.en: I bought and read Marianne's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, to accompany me while completing the clinical psychology training application.
sentences.zh: 我购买并阅读了Marianne的书《临床心理学家集体》，在完成临床心理学培训申请的过程中，它一直陪伴着我。

sentences.en: It proved to be a really good company.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，它确实是一个很好的伙伴。

sentences.en: I found it sparked ideas of how to build experience and skills, but more than that, it offered the chance to get lost in people's stories.
sentences.zh: 我发现它激发了我关于如何积累经验和技能的想法，但更重要的是，它提供了沉浸在他人故事中的机会。

sentences.en: It provided a timely reminder not to get so caught up in an end goal and to value and enjoy each job we fulfil along the way,
sentences.zh: 它及时提醒我，不要太执着于最终目标，而要重视并享受我们一路走来所完成的每一份工作，

sentences.en: because the work we do now is important and matters to those we sit alongside, as well as ourselves.
sentences.zh: 因为我们现在所做的工作很重要，对我们身边的人以及我们自己都有意义。

sentences.en: It also gave the reassurance that there are eclectic routes into clinical psychology,
sentences.zh: 它还让我确信，进入临床心理学领域有多种多样的途径，

sentences.en: which is important for me as someone who's had a meandering journey and not a typical route to the profession.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说很重要，因为我走的是一条蜿蜒曲折的道路，而不是进入该行业的典型路线。

sentences.en: I wholeheartedly recommend the book for both personal and professional reasons.
sentences.zh: 我衷心推荐这本书，无论是出于个人原因还是职业原因。

sentences.en: Be prepared to put evening tasks on hold for a while, though, because once you've started reading, it's tough to put it down.
sentences.zh: 不过，要做好暂时搁置晚间任务的准备，因为一旦开始阅读，就很难放下了。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这本书成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring with Dr. Marianne.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将在Marianne博士的陪伴下走上追求梦想的道路。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎来到“追求梦想的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: Today is going to be quite a raw and honest podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 今天这一集会非常真实和坦诚。

sentences.en: I hope you find it useful and I hope that you are able to use it and the approaches within it to reflect,
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得它有用，也希望你能利用它以及其中的方法来进行反思，

sentences.en: perhaps in your own practice or perhaps going through your day-to-day life in a mindful way, perhaps in supervision, perhaps as a reflective journal exercise.
sentences.zh: 也许是在你自己的实践中，也许是在日常生活中以正念的方式，也许是在督导中，也许是作为反思日记的练习。

sentences.en: But I try to showcase the way that I live my life and how I use my own knowledge, not only for the clients I work with, but also for myself.
sentences.zh: 但我试图展示我生活的方式，以及我如何运用自己的知识，不仅是为了我合作的客户，也是为了我自己。

sentences.en: And that is the topic of today's episode is when you can use your own knowledge to apply to yourself or to help work out what might be going on with you.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天这一集的主题：当你能运用自己的知识来应用于自身，或帮助弄清楚自己身上可能发生了什么时。

sentences.en: So, yeah, here it goes.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，开始了。

sentences.en: I thought we would do this by looking at my life and my behavior through a few key areas, key times where I wasn't feeling tip-top.
sentences.zh: 我想我们通过审视我的生活和行为的几个关键领域，以及我感觉不太好的关键时刻来完成这一点。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's think about the first one that comes to mind and it is in 2013.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们想想第一个浮现在脑海中的时刻，那是2013年。

sentences.en: And at that point, I have got a six weeks old baby, my first child, and I had had no sleep for precisely six weeks and about two days.
sentences.zh: 那时，我有一个六周大的婴儿，我的第一个孩子，我已经整整六周零两天没睡过觉了。

sentences.en: Um, I had only just been able to start driving again because I'd had an emergency section and, um, you can't have, you can't start driving again until you've been signed off, um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我才刚刚能开始开车，因为我做了紧急剖腹产，嗯，你不能，你必须在被确认，嗯，

sentences.en: as safe to do so.
sentences.zh: 安全的情况下才能开始开车。

sentences.en: Um, and that's usually around your six-week check.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这通常是在你六周检查的时候。

sentences.en: Um, so I was like home with my baby who I was just on cloud nine with.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我当时和我的宝宝待在家里，我简直高兴坏了。

sentences.en: So despite the fact that he was an utter, utter sleep thief, at worst he woke like 31 times a night.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管他是一个彻头彻尾的“睡眠小偷”，最糟糕的时候他一晚上会醒来31次。

sentences.en: He was an absolute terror when it came to night time.
sentences.zh: 他在晚上简直是个小恶魔。

sentences.en: He also didn't really like night time very much either.
sentences.zh: 他自己其实也不太喜欢晚上。

sentences.en: Um, but at all other times he was joyful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但在其他所有时间里，他都很开心。

sentences.en: He was so smiley and gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 他总是笑眯眯的，非常可爱。

sentences.en: And I just adored being his mummy.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢做他的妈妈。

sentences.en: I still do.
sentences.zh: 我现在依然如此。

sentences.en: It's just, oh, I just felt like it was just me and him.
sentences.zh: 只是，哦，我感觉就像只有我和他一样。

sentences.en: So I am married.
sentences.zh: 我是已婚的。

sentences.en: I was still married at the time, but it was just like, it was just this, just unique adoration, just like amazing.
sentences.zh: 当时我还是已婚状态，但这就像，这只是一种，独特的崇拜，简直太神奇了。

sentences.en: It's just like we'd both landed on like planet perfection apart from, and aside from the fact that he did not sleep.
sentences.zh: 就像我们俩都降落在了完美星球上，除了他睡觉这一点之外。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, who is this child?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这孩子是谁啊？

sentences.en: Because I love sleep.
sentences.zh: 因为我热爱睡眠。

sentences.en: Uh, prior to becoming a mummy, it was not unheard of me, um, to have a lie in, um, on days when I wasn't working and then wake up and then have some breakfast and then have a nap.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在成为妈妈之前，我，嗯，在不工作的日子里睡个懒觉，然后醒来吃点早餐，再小睡一会儿，这对我来说并不罕见。

sentences.en: Um, and then sometimes I don't even have an afternoon nap and then I'd go to sleep and sleep all night long.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有时候我甚至不睡午觉，然后我就去睡觉，整晚睡得香甜。

sentences.en: Um, I loved sleep.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我热爱睡眠。

sentences.en: So to then have this child who really was not finding sleep that natural, um, which I know is really common.
sentences.zh: 所以，当有了这个觉得睡觉一点也不自然的孩子时，嗯，我知道这很常见。

sentences.en: And then I just was not prepared for how exhausting that would be.
sentences.zh: 我当时完全没有准备好这会有多让人精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Um, you know, I don't know if you've ever been that tired, but when I reflect on that time, I think about it, not necessarily so much in the six weeks, first six weeks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我不知道你是否曾经那么累，但当我反思那段时间时，我想到的不一定是前六周。

sentences.en: Well, it was difficult to begin with, but it went on until he was 20 months, his sleep chaos.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一开始确实很困难，但他的睡眠混乱一直持续到他20个月大。

sentences.en: Um, but at times, you know, if it'd been particularly wild at night, there'd been many, many wakings, perhaps after only 40 minutes of my sleep, for example.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但有时，你知道，如果晚上特别疯狂，醒来很多次，可能我只睡了40分钟，例如。

sentences.en: So I was just really shattered and I just felt cold to my bones, even on a warm day, I felt like head fog and I was more likely to eat rubbish, um,
sentences.zh: 所以我真的筋疲力尽，即使在温暖的日子里，我也觉得冷到骨子里，感觉头脑昏沉，而且我更容易吃垃圾食品，嗯，

sentences.en: because of the unique way that our, um, our ghrelin, ghrelin, ghrelin, how do you say it?
sentences.zh: 因为我们的，嗯，我们的饥饿素，饥饿素，饥饿素，你怎么说它？

sentences.en: I have no idea, but it's a, it's a hormone, which is really indicated in our eating and our eating, um, hormone suppressant when we've had enough to eat.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但它是一种激素，与我们的进食有关，当我们吃饱时，它是一种激素抑制剂。

sentences.en: Um, but there's also leptin as well, which I believe is quite indicated in appetite.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还有瘦素，我相信它与食欲有很大关系。

sentences.en: Um, and both of those hormones are affected when we are very tired.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们非常疲倦时，这两种激素都会受到影响。

sentences.en: Um, so we might find that there's some evidence, even that people at buffets, if they've been sleep deprived, um, will consume.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我们可能会发现一些证据，甚至显示在自助餐时，如果人们睡眠不足，嗯，会摄入。

sentences.en: More calories than people who've had, um, you know, seven and a half to eight hours plus sleep per night.
sentences.zh: 比每晚睡眠七个半到八小时以上的人更多的热量。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, this stuff matters.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以是的，这些事情很重要。

sentences.en: So the time I'm telling you about is when he was just over six weeks old, I'd been able to get out and about in my car.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉你的那个时候是他刚过六周大，我已经能开车出门了。

sentences.en: So I'd been to, um, a breastfeeding support group, um, was just trying to work out why, why it was all still kind of quite painful.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了，嗯，一个母乳喂养支持小组，嗯，只是想弄清楚为什么，为什么一切仍然感觉相当痛苦。

sentences.en: Um, and very quickly, um, he was assessed by a lactation consultant and she was like, he's got a posterior tongue tie.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很快，嗯，他被一位哺乳顾问评估了，她说，他有后舌系带过短。

sentences.en: Um, and yeah, there's some people that don't think that's a thing, but I could promise you from the state of my body at that time, um, it's a thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，有些人认为这不是一回事，但我可以根据当时我身体的状态向你保证，嗯，这是一回事。

sentences.en: I absolutely am on board with that being a thing and it should not have been hurting me as much as it was.
sentences.zh: 我绝对同意这是一回事，它不应该让我感到那么痛苦。

sentences.en: Um, and on that same, um, couple of days, it might maybe even have been the same day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在那几天，甚至可能是同一天。

sentences.en: Um, he was assessed by, um, the GP for his kind of six week check.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他被全科医生评估了他的六周检查。

sentences.en: And they kind of said, oh, I think, um, I think he might have a bit of a squint, um, in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，我想，嗯，我想他可能有点斜视，嗯，在他的眼睛里。

sentences.en: He's not focusing quite right.
sentences.zh: 他聚焦得不太对。

sentences.en: And we'd have expected it ordinarily to have corrected by now.
sentences.zh: 我们通常预计它现在应该已经矫正了。

sentences.en: Um, so babies are often born that way, but usually by about that age, it's, it's sort of corrected itself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以婴儿出生时经常那样，但通常到了那个年龄，它，它已经自行矫正了。

sentences.en: And I remember, um, bathing him that night in the bath and just crying, really.
sentences.zh: 我记得，嗯，那天晚上给他洗澡时，我只是在哭，真的。

sentences.en: I was thinking, oh, this like perfect baby, um, now potentially needs some kind of minor surgery to his tongue.
sentences.zh: 我在想，哦，这个完美的宝宝，嗯，现在可能需要对他舌头进行某种小手术。

sentences.en: I might need to have all sorts of appointments to help correct this squint.
sentences.zh: 我可能需要进行各种预约来帮助矫正这个斜视。

sentences.en: And I just thought, oh, this is really sad.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，哦，这真的很令人难过。

sentences.en: I'm really sad.
sentences.zh: 我真的很伤心。

sentences.en: I'm really, really sad.
sentences.zh: 我真的，真的很伤心。

sentences.en: Um, and then I was, and of course I was really tired.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后我，当然我真的很累。

sentences.en: I was meeting a friend, um, who is a fellow clean psych and he's now a mother, um, but wasn't at the time.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在见一位朋友，嗯，她也是一位临床心理学家，现在也是一位母亲，嗯，但当时还不是。

sentences.en: I was meeting her for lunch in town.
sentences.zh: 我当时在城里和她吃午饭。

sentences.en: Um, I think probably the following day or soon after that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想可能是第二天或者在那之后不久。

sentences.en: And we just sat there and I just had a good old cry.
sentences.zh: 我们只是坐在那里，我痛痛快快地哭了一场。

sentences.en: Um, and, um, she was worried about me and my mental health at that time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，嗯，她当时很担心我和我的心理健康。

sentences.en: I think she thought I was perhaps, you know, developing postnatal depression or I wasn't coping very well.
sentences.zh: 我想她可能认为我，你知道，患上了产后抑郁症，或者我应对得不太好。

sentences.en: So she wasn't worried that I was concerned, um, to my baby.
sentences.zh: 所以她并不担心我会伤害我的宝宝。

sentences.en: Um, she was just worried about me as a friend and worried about me because of her knowledge of psychology too.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她只是作为朋友担心我，也因为她对心理学的了解而担心我。

sentences.en: Um, but I was able to use my theory, um, and my reflections to know I wasn't experiencing depression at that stage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我能够运用我的理论，嗯，和我的反思来知道我当时并没有经历抑郁症。

sentences.en: Um, so I think an outsider and a GP, if I'd been honest with them at that point, they might well have just indicated, you know, suggested that that's postnatal depression.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我认为局外人和全科医生，如果我当时对他们诚实的话，他们很可能会指出，你知道，建议那是产后抑郁症。

sentences.en: You know, but actually I knew for me that it wasn't because I was still finding joy in him and in activities.
sentences.zh: 你知道，但实际上我知道对我来说不是，因为我仍然在他身上和活动中找到快乐。

sentences.en: I was still eating.
sentences.zh: 我还在吃东西。

sentences.en: I was still sleeping when I could.
sentences.zh: 我还在能睡的时候睡觉。

sentences.en: Um, I was just reacting to what felt like two quite big hiccups, um, with my baby, you know, with his health.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我只是对感觉像是两个相当大的波折做出了反应，嗯，关于我的宝宝，你知道，关于他的健康。

sentences.en: Um, and I just, it just took a little bit of time to adjust for that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我只是，这确实花了一点时间来适应。

sentences.en: Um, and by eight weeks, his tongue, um, procedure had been done and things had settled down a bit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到了八周时，他的舌头，嗯，手术已经完成了，事情也稍微平息了一些。

sentences.en: And I was hoping that that might improve his sleep.
sentences.zh: 我当时希望这能改善他的睡眠。

sentences.en: And of course it didn't.
sentences.zh: 当然没有。

sentences.en: Um, but then he was feeding better.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但他吃得更好了。

sentences.en: And so my body was more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 所以我的身体更舒服了。

sentences.en: And so I just really felt like I really moved into just my flow of being a mummy, even though I was a tired mummy at that stage.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的觉得我进入了做妈妈的状态，尽管那时我是一个疲惫的妈妈。

sentences.en: And so things got better at that point and, and more effortless.
sentences.zh: 所以事情在那时变得更好了，而且，更轻松了。

sentences.en: And there was still so much joy and adoration around, um, despite the fact that he was an absolute sleep monkey.
sentences.zh: 尽管他是一个绝对的“睡眠小猴子”，但周围仍然充满了快乐和崇拜。

sentences.en: Now, thankfully his squint did sort itself out.
sentences.zh: 现在，谢天谢地，他的斜视确实自行解决了。

sentences.en: Um, so he never needed any treatment for that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以他从来不需要为此进行任何治疗。

sentences.en: It did resolve, which I was really pleased about.
sentences.zh: 它确实解决了，我对此感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: But I think I could easily have been pathologized at that stage as being depressed.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我当时很容易被病理化为抑郁症。

sentences.en: But I was able to use that to know that I was just reacting to life events.
sentences.zh: 但我能够利用这一点来知道我只是对生活事件做出了反应。

sentences.en: Um, and that is not to disparage anyone who is experiencing postnatal depression at all.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这绝不是要贬低任何正在经历产后抑郁症的人。

sentences.en: This is just my observation of knowing my own self really well and knowing, you know, the markers for depression, um, and feeling that they didn't apply to me.
sentences.zh: 这只是我非常了解自己，并且知道，你知道，抑郁症的标志，嗯，并觉得它们不适用于我的观察。

sentences.en: It didn't, you know, it wasn't depression I was experiencing because we must allow and tolerate that our lives will have ebbs and flows, that sometimes we will feel better.
sentences.zh: 它不是，你知道，我经历的不是抑郁症，因为我们必须允许并容忍我们的生活会有起伏，有时我们会感觉更好。

sentences.en: Sometimes we will feel worse.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会感觉更糟。

sentences.en: And it's the good times that highlight the bad times, but it's also going through the bad times, which really highlight the great times, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 美好的时光突显了糟糕的时光，但经历糟糕的时光也真正突显了美好的时光，不是吗？

sentences.en: If you can reflect on some of the happiest times in your life,
sentences.zh: 如果你能反思你生命中最快乐的一些时光，

sentences.en: perhaps it's when you've been in the first flushes of new relationship or you've just moved house or you've got a new job and you just are so delighted.
sentences.zh: 也许是你刚开始一段新恋情的时候，或者你刚搬家，或者你得到了一份新工作，你感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: You know, you reflect on how easily things seem to come to you, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你反思事情似乎是多么容易地来到你身边，你知道，

sentences.en: how easily you'll smile at that point and how easy you find it to talk about yourself and how joyful you find things.
sentences.zh: 那时你微笑是多么容易，你发现谈论自己是多么容易，你发现事情是多么令人愉快。

sentences.en: And how much joy you're able to find in yourself and in your activities and in the things you do with people.
sentences.zh: 以及你能在自己、活动以及你与他人所做的事情中找到多少快乐。

sentences.en: And sometimes you just can't keep that smile off your face.
sentences.zh: 有时你就是无法掩饰脸上的笑容。

sentences.en: And that's a really, really lovely life stage.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常、非常可爱的人生阶段。

sentences.en: And you must breathe into that.
sentences.zh: 你必须呼吸进去。

sentences.en: You must lean into it.
sentences.zh: 你必须倾注其中。

sentences.en: You must recognize it.
sentences.zh: 你必须认识到它。

sentences.en: It's okay to mindfully celebrate and reflect upon and kind of draw down upon those really good felt times to be able to draw on and reflect upon and to help you through times that feel less good.
sentences.zh: 以正念的方式庆祝、反思并汲取那些美好的感觉时刻，以便在感觉不太好的时候能够利用和反思它们，这是没问题的。

sentences.en: You know, you just know that better times are coming.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只需要知道更好的时光即将到来。

sentences.en: Whatever you're experiencing right now, there's always hope.
sentences.zh: 无论你现在正在经历什么，总有希望。

sentences.en: I firmly believe that.
sentences.zh: 我坚信这一点。

sentences.en: So let's break here for a short little snippet where we talk about the Aspiring Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们在这里休息一下，谈谈《追求梦想的心理学家集体》这本书。

sentences.en: And I will be back along very, very shortly to talk with you about some more observations and reflections about my own mental health and my well-being journey.
sentences.zh: 我很快就会回来，和你谈谈关于我自己的心理健康和幸福之旅的更多观察和反思。

sentences.en: The Clinical Psychologist Collective book was a very helpful read and useful to step outside of the prep work for the DeclinSci application process.
sentences.zh: 《临床心理学家集体》这本书是一本非常有帮助的读物，对于跳出DeclinSci申请过程的准备工作很有用。

sentences.en: To really consider if this is something you want to do and reflect on your personal journey.
sentences.zh: 去真正考虑这是否是你想要做的事情，并反思你的个人旅程。

sentences.en: It is a very nice read and kept me company on train journeys.
sentences.zh: 这是一本非常好的读物，在火车旅行中陪伴了我。

sentences.en: I do think Marianne's guidance through her podcast, Compassionate Q&A Sessions and this book has played a part in my successful application this year.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为Marianne通过她的播客、富有同情心的问答环节和这本书提供的指导，在我今年的成功申请中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Welcome back along.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for staying tuned in and I hope you found that useful.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的收听，希望你觉得它有用。

sentences.en: So let's think about what I'm not saying during this episode.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们思考一下我在这一集中没有说的话。

sentences.en: So I'm absolutely not saying that it's not possible to develop mental health difficulties.
sentences.zh: 所以我绝对不是说发展心理健康困难是不可能的。

sentences.en: I'm absolutely not saying that there's anything wrong with you or other people if they do.
sentences.zh: 我绝对不是说如果你或其他人在经历这些时有什么问题。

sentences.en: What I am talking about is using our extensive skills and training to try and do a bit of an audit of ourselves really and to look at using those skills in really being really super self-aware and reflective to kind of act as early help for yourself.
sentences.zh: 我所谈论的是利用我们广泛的技能和培训来尝试对自己进行一点审计，并着眼于利用这些技能，真正地做到超级自我意识和反思，从而为你自己起到早期帮助的作用。

sentences.en: And for me, I think about it as almost like daily gardening really for my mental health, you know, just having a little bit of an overview of where I'm at.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我把它看作几乎就像我心理健康的日常园艺，你知道，只是对自己所处的位置有一个小小的概述。

sentences.en: And I think that it can be, you know, really helpful to have this sort of approach in this sort of reflective style and space.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，拥有这种方法和这种反思风格和空间真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: And for me, I think it really helps make sure that what I'm experiencing as a state.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我认为它确实有助于确保我所经历的是一种状态。

sentences.en: And when I say state, I don't mean like, oh, you know, they were in a right state, although that's probably where it originates from.
sentences.zh: 当我说是状态时，我不是说，哦，你知道，他们处于一种正确的状态，尽管那可能就是它的起源。

sentences.en: A state is just, you know, something we're doing right now, but stops it from tipping over or developing into a trait.
sentences.zh: 状态只是，你知道，我们现在正在做的事情，但它阻止了它倾斜或发展成一种特质。

sentences.en: So for me, depression is when, you know, certain behaviours and, you know, symptoms and patterns of thinking and interacting start to become more entrenched.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，抑郁是指某些行为、症状以及思维和互动模式开始变得根深蒂固。

sentences.en: And so they're becoming, or they have become, or it seems like they are traits, like it won't change, that it's static.
sentences.zh: 它们正在变成，或者已经变成了某种特质，看起来就像是固定不变的，不会再改变了。

sentences.en: And for me, it's getting in ahead of that with myself, you know, to really do what I can do, to stay on top of that and to practice what I preach, I guess.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我需要先发制人，真正去做我力所能及的事，掌控局面，并且践行我所倡导的理念。

sentences.en: And I guess it might be useful for you to use some of these approaches with yourself and to be as open as I am being and to practice, if it feels safe,
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你能对自己运用这些方法，像我一样坦诚，并且在感觉安全的情况下进行练习，可能会有所帮助，

sentences.en: being as open as I am being in your supervision sessions, if that feels safe to do so.
sentences.zh: 如果感觉安全的话，在你的督导会议中也像我一样坦诚。

sentences.en: So that said, if you do want to register for my supervision guide, which can help you shape your supervision relationships,
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果你想注册我的督导指南，它可以帮助你塑造督导关系，

sentences.en: then head out to the details in the show notes or head to my website and then it's just forward slash supervision.
sentences.zh: 那么请查看节目说明中的详细信息，或者访问我的网站，网址后面加上斜杠 supervision 即可。

sentences.en: So, yeah, let's crash on with the rest of the episode, but just wanted to add that caveat so that you knew that I wasn't being all hatist at all.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们继续本期的内容，我只是想先加个免责声明，让你知道我绝不是在针对谁。

sentences.en: Absolutely not stacks of compassion for people that are experiencing mental health difficulties and distress.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是，我对那些正在经历心理健康困难和痛苦的人们充满了同情。

sentences.en: But this is some of the ways that I, I don't like the grammar there.
sentences.zh: 但这些是我所使用的一些方法，我不喜欢刚才那里的语法。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm going to edit that, but I'm not going to edit it out because I'm not, I'm not super perfectionistic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我应该编辑一下，但我不会删掉它，因为我并不是一个超级完美主义者。

sentences.en: So these are some of the ways that I use to just do a bit of weeding, you know, just to gently cogitate, assess, think what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是我用来清理思绪的一些方法，你知道，就是为了温和地沉思、评估、思考到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: You've been a bit crankier than usual lately, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安，你最近比平时脾气暴躁了一些。

sentences.en: What do you think that might be about?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: That's gentle curiosity that I would apply with clients as well.
sentences.zh: 这就是我也会对来访者运用的温和的好奇心。

sentences.en: Well, why don't we try and do that for a bit and we'll just see whether that helps.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们为什么不试着这样做一会儿，看看是否有帮助。

sentences.en: And so that's what I would expect from myself.
sentences.zh: 这就是我会对自己有的要求。

sentences.en: And that's what I would suggest can be useful when you're also working in mental health services and trying to look after yourself as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是我建议在心理健康服务领域工作并试图照顾好自己时，可以尝试的方法。

sentences.en: So, yeah, let's let's crack on.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们继续吧。

sentences.en: And yeah, just wanted to add that because it felt really important.
sentences.zh: 是的，我只是想补充这一点，因为它感觉真的很重要。

sentences.en: So the second time I'm going to talk to you about is something more recent, actually.
sentences.zh: 我要跟你谈的第二件事其实是最近发生的。

sentences.en: So it was in the run up to the summer holidays 2022.
sentences.zh: 那是在2022年暑假前夕。

sentences.en: And I just had started to recognise that I was a bit grumpier than I ought to be, you know.
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到自己比平时更暴躁了一些。

sentences.en: So my baseline is usually pretty cheery, you know.
sentences.zh: 通常我的基准状态是相当愉快的。

sentences.en: I'm usually pretty easygoing.
sentences.zh: 我通常很容易相处。

sentences.en: I usually smile quite often and, you know, can find the humour in most situations.
sentences.zh: 我通常经常微笑，并且能在大多数情况下找到幽默感。

sentences.en: And I just was like a bit irritable.
sentences.zh: 但我当时确实有点易怒。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, am I being irritable or is everyone around me actually really annoying?
sentences.zh: 我心想，是我变得易怒了，还是周围的人真的都很烦人？

sentences.en: You know, how do you discern that?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你怎么去分辨呢？

sentences.en: Is it me that's the problem?
sentences.zh: 问题出在我身上吗？

sentences.en: Or are they all really annoying?
sentences.zh: 还是他们真的都很烦人？

sentences.en: You know, I've got two kids and a husband.
sentences.zh: 我有两个孩子和一个丈夫。

sentences.en: Is it just them?
sentences.zh: 只是他们的问题吗？

sentences.en: Am I the problem?
sentences.zh: 我是那个有问题的人吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm not sure it's me.
sentences.zh: 我不确定是我。

sentences.en: Like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I thought, well, let's have a look at your life, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 但我心想，好吧，让我们看看你的生活，玛丽安。

sentences.en: Let's think about what might be going on to see if this could be you, actually.
sentences.zh: 让我们思考一下可能发生了什么，看看这是否真的是你的问题。

sentences.en: So I did a little bit of a dissection, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我做了一次小小的自我剖析。

sentences.en: And it might be helpful at this stage to have a look at the Maslow's hierarchy of needs.
sentences.zh: 在这个阶段，参考马斯洛需求层次理论可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: So at the bottom of that pyramid, I often do this with clients.
sentences.zh: 在金字塔的最底层，我经常和来访者一起做这个练习。

sentences.en: Not about myself, obviously.
sentences.zh: 当然不是针对我自己。

sentences.en: But with them, we look at the physiological needs, which is air, water, food, shelter, sleep, clothing, reproduction.
sentences.zh: 但和他们一起，我们会审视生理需求，即空气、水、食物、住所、睡眠、衣物、繁衍。

sentences.en: Then the next one up, we've got safety needs, which is personal security, employment, resources, health and property, love and belonging, friendship, intimacy, family,
sentences.zh: 接下来是安全需求，包括人身安全、就业、资源、健康和财产、爱与归属感、友谊、亲密关系、家庭，

sentences.en: sense of connection.
sentences.zh: 连接感。

sentences.en: Next one up is esteem, respect, self-esteem, status, recognition, strength and freedom.
sentences.zh: 再往上是尊重需求，包括尊重、自尊、地位、认可、力量和自由。

sentences.en: And then right at the top, we've got self-actualization, the desire to become the most that one can be.
sentences.zh: 最后在最顶端是自我实现，即成为自己所能成为的一切的渴望。

sentences.en: And so I was thinking, well, where am I doing really well at the moment?
sentences.zh: 我当时在想，我目前在哪些方面做得很好？

sentences.en: And I'm going to cite that one of the problems was Love Island, people.
sentences.zh: 我要指出其中一个问题是《恋爱岛》，各位。

sentences.en: Ordinarily, my natural bedtime would be about 9.15.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，我自然的就寝时间大约是9点15分。

sentences.en: But when Love Island's on, it doesn't finish till 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 但当《恋爱岛》播出时，它要到晚上10点才结束。

sentences.en: And I can't be catching up on TV every day because I'm very busy.
sentences.zh: 而且我不能每天都补看电视，因为我非常忙。

sentences.en: And so I was watching it live with my husband.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时和丈夫一起看直播。

sentences.en: We're both Love Island fans.
sentences.zh: 我们都是《恋爱岛》的粉丝。

sentences.en: Big news just in is that Laura Whitmore is not doing it next year.
sentences.zh: 刚刚得到的大新闻是劳拉·惠特莫尔明年不主持了。

sentences.en: Who's going to present?
sentences.zh: 谁会来主持呢？

sentences.en: Will it be Ekin Sue, I heard yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天听说会是埃金·苏。

sentences.en: I think that might be quite good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那可能还不错。

sentences.en: I might be on board with that.
sentences.zh: 我可能会支持这个决定。

sentences.en: But yeah, my sleep suffers.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我的睡眠受到了影响。

sentences.en: I get less of it, so to speak, during Love Island and not for the reasons you think.
sentences.zh: 在《恋爱岛》期间，我的睡眠时间变少了，并不是因为你以为的原因。

sentences.en: Just because it's later.
sentences.zh: 只是因为它太晚了。

sentences.en: So it pushes back my bedtime routine by an hour, really.
sentences.zh: 所以它确实把我的睡前准备时间推迟了一个小时。

sentences.en: You know, almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 几乎一个小时。

sentences.en: And, you know, also in the UK, since July, it's been unbearably hot.
sentences.zh: 而且在英国，自七月以来，天气热得让人难以忍受。

sentences.en: And in my 20s, and when I was a teenager, I loved hot weather.
sentences.zh: 在我二十多岁和青少年时期，我喜欢炎热的天气。

sentences.en: I was a real sun bunny.
sentences.zh: 我曾经是个十足的阳光爱好者。

sentences.en: I adored it.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: But now that I am older than mid-20s, I just don't like it.
sentences.zh: 但现在我过了二十五岁，我就是不喜欢它了。

sentences.en: It is not for me.
sentences.zh: 它不适合我。

sentences.en: I am not here for that.
sentences.zh: 我可受不了这个。

sentences.en: Anything over 24.
sentences.zh: 任何超过24度的天气。

sentences.en: And I am, like, grumpy.
sentences.zh: 我就会变得脾气暴躁。

sentences.en: I like to be a bit chilly in bed and to be all snuggled up and have a duvet.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在床上感觉凉爽一点，蜷缩起来，盖着被子。

sentences.en: I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我等不及了。

sentences.en: I can't wait to need a duvet again.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待地想再次需要盖被子了。

sentences.en: I cannot wait.
sentences.zh: 我真的等不及了。

sentences.en: I literally am kind of hallucinating about how wonderful that's going to be.
sentences.zh: 我简直是在幻想那会有多美妙。

sentences.en: And then in the next breath, I'm like, but, oh, then we might need heating.
sentences.zh: 但转念一想，我又觉得，哦，那我们可能需要开暖气了。

sentences.en: And the heating's going to be expensive.
sentences.zh: 而且暖气费会很贵。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I'm just looking forward to autumn when we don't need heating, but we can luxuriate in long trousers and blankets and pillows and, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，我真的很期待秋天，那时我们不需要暖气，但可以尽情穿着长裤，裹着毯子和枕头，你知道，

sentences.en: that aren't covered in sweat and, you know, duvets that are wonderful.
sentences.zh: 不用被汗水浸透，还有那些美妙的被子。

sentences.en: So I blooming can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我真是太期待了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, my sleep was being impacted on by that.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的睡眠确实受到了影响。

sentences.en: But so, yeah, I decided to to take that on board once Love Island was finished.
sentences.zh: 所以，在《恋爱岛》结束后，我决定把这些调整回来。

sentences.en: Let's not go wild.
sentences.zh: 我们别太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I'm not quitting mid-series.
sentences.zh: 我不会在节目播出一半时就放弃。

sentences.en: But I decided to get my sleep hygiene back on board.
sentences.zh: 但我决定重新找回我的睡眠卫生习惯。

sentences.en: So I'm never really a caffeine drinker anyway.
sentences.zh: 我本来就不是个喝咖啡因的人。

sentences.en: I have the occasional cup of green tea.
sentences.zh: 我偶尔会喝一杯绿茶。

sentences.en: I don't eat much chocolate.
sentences.zh: 我不怎么吃巧克力。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I decided to see if I could start going to bed slightly earlier again.
sentences.zh: 但我决定看看能不能再次开始早点睡觉。

sentences.en: And I have done that.
sentences.zh: 我已经做到了。

sentences.en: And I looked at my food.
sentences.zh: 我还审视了我的饮食。

sentences.en: So if you've been following me on Instagram, Dr. Marianne Trent, where all the good stuff happens on Insta, I decided to start trying to eat a bit better.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直关注我的 Instagram，Dr. Marianne Trent，那里有所有精彩的内容，我决定开始尝试吃得更好一点。

sentences.en: So I decided to start trying to eat a bit more fruit and veg.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定开始尝试多吃点水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: And a couple of years ago, I was doing a 10 a day to eating 80 grams of 10 different fruit and veg for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我坚持了一整年每天吃10种不同的水果和蔬菜，每种80克。

sentences.en: I did it for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 我坚持了一整年。

sentences.en: And at that point, I thought, I'm never going to change back.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我想，我永远不会变回去了。

sentences.en: Well, this is just going to be me forever now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是我以后的样子了。

sentences.en: Like, this is just going to be this is going to be where it's at.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的生活方式了。

sentences.en: You know, I can't see me ever changing, ever having this be any different.
sentences.zh: 我看不出自己会有什么改变，也不会有任何不同。

sentences.en: But then, of course, like anything, things do change.
sentences.zh: 但当然，像任何事情一样，情况确实会发生变化。

sentences.en: So once I've done the year, things slipped.
sentences.zh: 所以一年结束后，情况就有所松懈。

sentences.en: And before, you know, I was back down to probably eating a few portions a day.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，我又回到了每天只吃几份的状态。

sentences.en: But I just thought, you know what?
sentences.zh: 但我心想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to look at what changes I can make right now to really give myself the best chance of meeting my nutritional needs to support my optimal functioning,
sentences.zh: 我要看看现在能做出什么改变，真正给自己最好的机会去满足营养需求，以支持我的最佳状态，

sentences.en: which is what this is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我做这些的目的。

sentences.en: And so I started taking vitamins every day again.
sentences.zh: 所以我又开始每天服用维生素了。

sentences.en: And because I am, I was going to say an older lady.
sentences.zh: 因为我，我本来想说是一位上了年纪的女士。

sentences.en: I'm not an older lady, but I'm 41.
sentences.zh: 我不是一位上了年纪的女士，但我41岁了。

sentences.en: So I've got to be thinking about our bone density, started taking some calcium and vitamin D as well alongside that and some fish oils.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须考虑骨密度，除了维生素，还开始服用钙片和维生素D，以及一些鱼油。

sentences.en: But also started, I decided to buy a slow juicer.
sentences.zh: 此外，我还决定买一台慢速榨汁机。

sentences.en: And if you'd like some more information about my slow juicer, you can find that in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解更多关于我的慢速榨汁机的信息，可以在节目说明中找到。

sentences.en: We'll pop that in there for you.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它放在那里供你参考。

sentences.en: But yeah, slow juicer.
sentences.zh: 总之，慢速榨汁机。

sentences.en: And I started doing some juicing.
sentences.zh: 我开始榨汁了。

sentences.en: And I've been really, really enjoying that.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常非常享受这个过程。

sentences.en: So I've been adding to my stories some of the bits and pieces that I've been eating and drinking, but really enjoying it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在故事里分享我吃喝的一些东西，真的很享受。

sentences.en: And yeah, I'm not going to go all renegade and say I'm going to do it every day for the rest of my life like I did with the 10 a day.
sentences.zh: 我不会变得那么极端，说我要像之前坚持每天吃10种果蔬那样，余生每天都榨汁。

sentences.en: But I certainly am enjoying that.
sentences.zh: 但我确实很享受这个过程。

sentences.en: And so I'm going to continue that.
sentences.zh: 所以我打算继续下去。

sentences.en: So that's probably it for the bottom section.
sentences.zh: 所以底层需求的部分大概就是这样。

sentences.en: Then, you know, I am not employed.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我不是受雇于人。

sentences.en: I am self-employed, but I was feeling safe.
sentences.zh: 我是自雇人士，但我感觉很安全。

sentences.en: You know, I was feeling healthy.
sentences.zh: 我感觉很健康。

sentences.en: So I'm in good health.
sentences.zh: 所以我身体状况良好。

sentences.en: But I decided I would start running again.
sentences.zh: 但我决定重新开始跑步。

sentences.en: So I'm doing strength training.
sentences.zh: 我正在进行力量训练。

sentences.en: But over the summer, I'm only doing once a week, not twice, because I've got kids, man.
sentences.zh: 但在夏天，我每周只做一次，而不是两次，因为我有孩子，天哪。

sentences.en: I've got two of them.
sentences.zh: 我有两个孩子。

sentences.en: And so to be around for them a bit more often, I was doing strength training in the middle of the week, whereas I'd usually do it twice a week.
sentences.zh: 为了多花点时间陪他们，我把力量训练安排在周中，而通常我会每周做两次。

sentences.en: And I decided, well, I can start running again so I can start running before I start work or if I'm not working, I can do it at the weekends before I get showered and things.
sentences.zh: 我决定，我可以重新开始跑步，这样我可以在开始工作前跑步，或者如果不工作，我可以在周末洗澡前跑步。

sentences.en: So I started running again.
sentences.zh: 所以我重新开始跑步了。

sentences.en: And I'm not a marathon runner.
sentences.zh: 我不是马拉松选手。

sentences.en: I'm not very good at it, if I'm honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我跑得并不好。

sentences.en: It's not really about that for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，重点不在于此。

sentences.en: It's not about the speed.
sentences.zh: 不在于速度。

sentences.en: It's not about the distance.
sentences.zh: 不在于距离。

sentences.en: I only run for about 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我只跑大约15分钟。

sentences.en: It's about moving my body and knowing that my mental health responds really well to having been run like a dog, like getting out, getting some fresh air, having that time to think,
sentences.zh: 重点在于活动身体，并且知道我的心理健康在像狗一样奔跑后会得到很好的改善，比如出去走走，呼吸新鲜空气，有时间思考，

sentences.en: oh, look, there's blackberries going on that bush.
sentences.zh: 哦，看，那个灌木丛上有黑莓。

sentences.en: Oh, there's a dog poo there.
sentences.zh: 哦，那里有一坨狗屎。

sentences.en: Missed that.
sentences.zh: 差点踩到。

sentences.en: Avoid, avoid, avoid.
sentences.zh: 避开，避开，避开。

sentences.en: Or just saying hi to people in the street, you know, and, you know, catching, you know, flowers coming out for the first time.
sentences.zh: 或者只是和街上的人打个招呼，你知道，捕捉到第一次绽放的花朵。

sentences.en: And watching the way the breeze moves the trees and noticing how parched all of the grass is and stuff at the moment.
sentences.zh: 看着微风吹动树木的样子，注意到现在的草地是多么干枯。

sentences.en: So getting out and about is really useful for me.
sentences.zh: 所以走出去对我来说真的很有用。

sentences.en: I respond well to that.
sentences.zh: 我对此反应良好。

sentences.en: But depending on your own unique physiology and your physical health, you may not be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 但根据你独特的生理状况和身体健康水平，你可能无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: But still, moving your body is really useful for our mental health.
sentences.zh: 不过，多活动身体对我们的心理健康确实大有裨益。

sentences.en: I almost said yental health then, mental health.
sentences.zh: 我刚才差点说成“生理健康”了，是心理健康。

sentences.en: So, yeah, could you look to do that as well?
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，你能试着也这样做吗？

sentences.en: Love and belonging.
sentences.zh: 爱与归属感。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I felt like me and my husband are in a pretty good place.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我觉得我和我丈夫现在的状态挺好的。

sentences.en: We've been together almost 13 years and married almost 10.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起快13年了，结婚也快10年了。

sentences.en: So it's certainly not the first flash of love.
sentences.zh: 所以这当然不是那种初恋时的激情。

sentences.en: And we have got two children.
sentences.zh: 我们还有两个孩子。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I felt like we were good enough where we're at.
sentences.zh: 但，没错，我觉得我们目前的状态已经足够好了。

sentences.en: We like each other.
sentences.zh: 我们彼此喜欢。

sentences.en: We still make each other laugh.
sentences.zh: 我们依然能逗对方笑。

sentences.en: We like spending time together.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢共度时光。

sentences.en: We do tend to protect at least an hour together each evening when we're both in.
sentences.zh: 只要我们都在家，我们通常会尽量留出至少一小时的独处时间。

sentences.en: We're usually both in.
sentences.zh: 我们通常都在家。

sentences.en: To spend time together.
sentences.zh: 用来共度时光。

sentences.en: Before we had kids, we'd do, like, cool stuff.
sentences.zh: 在有孩子之前，我们会做些很酷的事情。

sentences.en: Like, play rummy, have a glass of wine maybe sometimes.
sentences.zh: 比如玩拉米纸牌，偶尔喝杯红酒什么的。

sentences.en: And play downfall.
sentences.zh: 还会玩“Downfall”游戏。

sentences.en: You won't beat me at downfall.
sentences.zh: 你在“Downfall”里是赢不了我的。

sentences.en: Don't think you can because you won't.
sentences.zh: 别以为你能赢，因为你赢不了。

sentences.en: Very rarely does anyone beat me at downfall.
sentences.zh: 很少有人能在“Downfall”里赢过我。

sentences.en: But, yeah, we'd spend time doing stuff other than watching TV.
sentences.zh: 但，没错，我们以前会花时间做些除了看电视以外的事情。

sentences.en: But largely these days we do watch TV.
sentences.zh: 不过如今我们大部分时间都在看电视。

sentences.en: But we spend time together usually on a Saturday and we'll have an earlier tea together, just me and him, once the kids are in bed.
sentences.zh: 但我们通常会在周六花时间在一起，等孩子们睡了，我和他会早点一起吃晚饭。

sentences.en: And we spend time together then as well.
sentences.zh: 那时候我们也会共度时光。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I felt like that was good.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我觉得那样很好。

sentences.en: But I recognise that even though I've got loads of friends, that most of them are not on my immediate doorstep.
sentences.zh: 但我意识到，尽管我有很多朋友，但大多数都不住在附近。

sentences.en: But I'm very, very fortunate that one of my children has got a best friend.
sentences.zh: 但我非常非常幸运，我的一个孩子有一个好朋友。

sentences.en: And it just so turns out that me and his mum get on really, really well.
sentences.zh: 而且碰巧我和他妈妈也非常合得来。

sentences.en: And so I decided that, yeah, we'll start spending some more time together as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定，嗯，我们要开始多花些时间在一起了。

sentences.en: It doesn't just need to be when the kids are, you know, together.
sentences.zh: 不一定非得是孩子们在一起的时候才能见面。

sentences.en: And so we've been planning more time together.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直在计划多聚聚。

sentences.en: We're off out together for dinner for the first time this coming Friday, actually, as I record this.
sentences.zh: 说实话，在我录这段音频的时候，我们已经定好这周五第一次一起出去吃晚餐了。

sentences.en: And, yeah, we just, I went around to see her the other day on her birthday.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，前几天她生日的时候，我刚去看了她。

sentences.en: We just, you know, laughed our heads off.
sentences.zh: 我们真是笑得前仰后合。

sentences.en: Like, it's just really nice to be able to have a friend right on my doorstep.
sentences.zh: 能有位住在附近的朋友真是太好了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I've got friends that I trained with that are living locally to me.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我确实有一起受训过的朋友住在本地。

sentences.en: But when I say locally to me, it's still about half an hour away.
sentences.zh: 但当我说是本地时，其实也要半小时车程。

sentences.en: And half an hour away may as well be, you know, three hours away because I still wasn't seeing them.
sentences.zh: 半小时车程和三小时车程也没什么区别，因为我还是没去见他们。

sentences.en: But I did make a trip to go and see two of my friends who live about half an hour away and really, really enjoyed connecting with them.
sentences.zh: 但我确实专门去看了两位住在半小时路程外的朋友，和她们交流真的非常非常开心。

sentences.en: And, yeah, right at the start of the summer, I went away and connected with three of my undergrad friends.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，就在夏天刚开始的时候，我出门去见了三位大学时的朋友。

sentences.en: And we went and stayed away in a beautiful little cottage with a hot tub.
sentences.zh: 我们住进了一个带热水浴缸的漂亮小屋。

sentences.en: It was really nice.
sentences.zh: 真的很棒。

sentences.en: So, just really looking at where I could thicken the narrative around my friendships to make sure that I was checking off that area of the Maslow's hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我只是在审视自己能在哪些方面加深友谊，以确保满足马斯洛需求层次理论中的这一部分。

sentences.en: And, yeah, continuing to plan in activities that are enjoyable and things to look forward to.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，继续规划一些令人愉快的活动，并对未来有所期待。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's the love and belonging section and the sense of connection and all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，这就是爱与归属感的部分，以及那种连接感等等。

sentences.en: And then really enjoyed our little family holiday as well when we went down to East Wittering, spending time together and also having a bit more sleep as well,
sentences.zh: 另外，我们去东威特灵（East Wittering）的那次家庭度假也非常愉快，我们在一起共度时光，还多睡了一会儿，

sentences.en: which topped up those needs.
sentences.zh: 这补充了那些需求。

sentences.en: And, yeah, just a more relaxed pace of life.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，生活节奏也更放松了。

sentences.en: So, you will know that I like to get things done.
sentences.zh: 你们知道我喜欢把事情做完。

sentences.en: You know, there's always busy plates spinning in my life, be they personal or professional or both.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的生活中总是有很多忙碌的事情，无论是私人的、工作的，还是两者兼有。

sentences.en: It was just nice to take my foot off the gas for a bit and just lean into being on holiday.
sentences.zh: 能稍微放慢脚步，享受度假的感觉真好。

sentences.en: Self-esteem, I feel like I respect myself, feeling all right, yeah, feeling okay with what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 自尊方面，我觉得我尊重自己，感觉还不错，嗯，对自己所做的事情感到满意。

sentences.en: And self-actualization, you know, I absolutely, even when I was feeling a bit wobbly and a bit moany and, you know, I still wanted to do well.
sentences.zh: 至于自我实现，你知道，我绝对是这样，即使在我感觉有点动摇、有点抱怨的时候，我依然想做得更好。

sentences.en: It wasn't like I was saying, oh, I can't do that and I mustn't do that.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我在对自己说，哦，我做不到，我不能那样做。

sentences.en: I just was a bit concerned about my general levels of irritability.
sentences.zh: 我只是有点担心自己整体的易怒水平。

sentences.en: And I can report, I'm recording this at the end of August, I'm feeling really good again.
sentences.zh: 我可以汇报一下，现在是八月底，我感觉又好起来了。

sentences.en: Um, so maybe, maybe it was me or maybe the children not being at school and not having to hustle them out the door is meaning they're less annoying.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以也许，也许是因为我，或者是因为孩子们不用上学，不用催着他们出门，所以他们没那么烦人了。

sentences.en: They are causing me to be less irritated.
sentences.zh: 他们让我感到没那么烦躁了。

sentences.en: Um, you know, we are spending time together.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们正在共度时光。

sentences.en: Um, and so they've got my attention.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以他们得到了我的关注。

sentences.en: I'm always quite careful that at the end of every day at bedtime that we have a little review of the day and, um, you know, we'll say, what's our favourite part of the day?
sentences.zh: 我总是很注意在每天睡觉前进行一个小小的回顾，嗯，你知道，我们会说，今天最喜欢的部分是什么？

sentences.en: What's our least favourite part of the day?
sentences.zh: 今天最不喜欢的部分是什么？

sentences.en: My eldest tries to chuck in what is my funniest part of the day?
sentences.zh: 我大儿子还会试图插嘴问：今天最有趣的部分是什么？

sentences.en: And I'm like, baby boy, life's not that funny when you're 41.
sentences.zh: 我就说，宝贝，当你41岁的时候，生活没那么有趣。

sentences.en: Like, it's very rare that I'll laugh my head off uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 我很难会笑得前仰后合、无法自控。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Max, and I work as an assistant psychologist in the Learning Disability Service in West Yorkshire.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是马克斯（Max），我在西约克郡的学习障碍服务中心担任助理心理学家。

sentences.en: Like most people working in psychology, I'm slowly but surely waking myself up to that seemingly impossible goal of getting onto the clinical doctorate.
sentences.zh: 像大多数从事心理学工作的人一样，我正在慢慢地、坚定地朝着那个看似不可能的目标努力——考取临床心理学博士学位。

sentences.en: With that end goal in mind, I thought I'd have a look at what's out there and see what books might be helpful for this.
sentences.zh: 怀着这个终极目标，我想看看市面上有什么书能对此有所帮助。

sentences.en: I came across Marianne's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, and decided that this would be a great buy for me to help me on my journey.
sentences.zh: 我发现了玛丽安（Marianne）的书《临床心理学家集体》（The Clinical Psychologist Collective），并决定买下它，这对我的旅程大有裨益。

sentences.en: I found Marianne's book really informative, most insightful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得玛丽安的书非常有信息量，见解深刻。

sentences.en: I especially liked how the stories reassured me that you don't need to be academically perfect to become a psychologist,
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢书中的故事，它们让我确信，成为一名心理学家并不需要学术上完美无缺，

sentences.en: and that as long as you have good interpersonal skills, such as compassion and empathy, you will get there.
sentences.zh: 只要你具备良好的社交技能，比如同情心和共情能力，你就能达到目标。

sentences.en: I would highly recommend this book to all aspiring psychologists, and also those who want to know a bit more about the world of clinical psychology,
sentences.zh: 我强烈向所有有志于成为心理学家的人推荐这本书，也推荐给那些想了解更多临床心理学世界的人，

sentences.en: and maybe want to work in that field one day.
sentences.zh: 或者未来可能想在这一领域工作的人。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间以外的钱，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特（Marianne Trent）博士，临床心理学家，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Money programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的“One2Money”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses, plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲提供的奖励，以及我额外提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组大师课、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日周一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 详情请查看描述中链接的我的奖励页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，随时可以找我。
